analyst_view.overall: Mallorca (6th, 24 points from 14) host second-placed Castellón (33 points) at Son Moix on Sunday in a top-six meeting. Mallorca are unbeaten in seven but have drawn four of their last five, the latest 0-0 at Tenerife, and have the second-best defence in the league behind Castellón, who have conceded only five goals in 14 games and won 1-0 at Valladolid and 2-0 against Eldense in recent weeks. Mallorca's injury list in the brief is long (Donald, Antonio Sánchez, Alberto Moreno, David López, Morlanes, Salas), but none of it moves the numbers much and it could not be checked against a second source this time; Castellón are missing only long-term absentee Brignani as far as was reported. Castellón face a heavy run before Christmas, including a postponed game at Eibar and a Copa tie with Cultural Leonesa. No referee is named and fresh news for this match was thin, so I stay with the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.2 goals and already rate Castellón's defence (five conceded in 14) and Mallorca's tight one (ten conceded). Mallorca's draws and Castellón's clean sheets both fit a low total, but that is already the numbers' view, and no lineup news could be confirmed, so I stay at 2.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 23.0 shots, with both sides trimmed a little for recent form. A cautious game between two of the best defences fits that low count, and nothing in the news changes it, so I stay at 23.0.
